icons.name: bomb
icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 256x256 game weapon inventory icon. Generate ONE replacement icon. Input images 1,2,3 (axe, pickaxe, club) are the EXACT style references: match their stout proportions, thick near-black uniform outlines, simple broad polygonal cel-shaded blue-gray steel, warm orange-brown wood and cream grip wraps. Image 4 is only the subject/color reference to redesign in the first three images' style. This must look drawn by the same artist and belong to the SAME SET as axe/pickaxe/club, not glossy smooth high-detail art. Clean simple recognizable silhouette; very few broad facets, no tiny details. Match outline weight and lighting top-left, minimal internal black contours. Centered in square, maximum object dimension about 85% of canvas, consistent padding. Genuine transparent alpha background. No frame, labels, text, circular badge, glow, shadow on background, excessive spark particles, realistic texture. Subject: a compact round orange-red explosive bomb with two broad blue-gray steel straps, stout neck and a short bent rope fuse with a single small yellow flame; simplify rivets to at most three broad studs.
